display.purpose: Compact conversation titles and identity labels.

mono.purpose: Tool details, measurements, and keyboard hints only.

shadows.name: floating-control
shadows.purpose: Ambient lift for sidebar, composer, menus, and islands.

shadows.name: conversation-shell
shadows.purpose: Stable depth for the reading container.

motion.name: menu-enter
motion.purpose: Short interruptible settle for pointer-opened menus.

motion.name: menu-exit
motion.purpose: Quick dismissal that never blocks reading.

motion.name: magnetic-follow
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer-only physical response for reusable controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast action with a tactile 44px target.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: var(--text); color: var(--surface-solid); min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; font: 500 0.6875rem/1.2 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--accent); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass Surface
components.description: Shared translucent material for floating controls.
components.css: .ds-glass { border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--material); box-shadow: var(--shadow-float); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.38); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.38); padding: 12px; color: var(--text); font: 400 0.8125rem/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Quiet raised field for finding conversation history.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--text-faint); } .ds-search input { width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: 400 0.6875rem/1.2 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--line)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }

components.name: Operational Row
components.description: Two-line tool or approval state attached to the conversation.
components.css: .ds-event { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 11px; min-height: 72px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--text); font: 500 0.72rem/1.3 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-event-icon { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); } .ds-event small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--text-faint); font: 400 0.64rem/1.35 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Hermternal is a calm instrument for issuing a direction and inspecting what follows. The interface keeps agent work readable in one thread, with translucent controls floating above a cool graphite reading surface.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep the accent concentrated on state, action, and focus.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a second UI font; use Geist Mono only for code or measurements.

rules.name: The Material Consistency Rule
rules.body: Transparent surfaces share opacity, blur, saturation, edge, and fallback values.

dos: Do preserve the open reading hierarchy.
donts: Don't stack title and subtitle in compact controls.
Don't imply live gateway integrations in this prototype.
